text:
Priya Patel: Quick sync: proposing 'adaptive batching' scope for next sprint — per-tenant dynamic batch cap + KV-cache hinting + quantization recs API + eval-triggered alerts. Want to lock scope by EOD Thu.

Tom Brooks: Sounds good. Need clarity on SLO impact and rollout gating. How do we measure latency regressions?

Marta Li: Can we make initial rollout opt-in per customer? Many enterprise customers need fixed per-request latency guarantees.

Priya Patel: Yes — rollout plan: default off, pilot whitelist, Console flag for canary routing. Example config prototype:
```
adaptive_batching:
  enabled: false
  pilot_customers: ["cust-123", "cust-456"]
  max_batch_per_tenant: dynamic
```

Kevin Zhao: Customer A asked that quant recs include a `memory_estimate` and `perf_delta_rps` so they can evaluate cost tradeoffs. Can we add those fields?

Tom Brooks: We can expose rough `memory_estimate` from quant profiles (±10-15%) and an RPS proxy `perf_delta_rps` from perf regressions. We'll document accuracy.

Marta Li: For eval-triggered alerts: need mapping from prompt-set -> threshold -> alert action. Also avoid noise by requiring N failing evals in window before firing.

Priya Patel: Proposal: per-prompt-set thresholds, sliding window 3 failures in 1 hour, severity mapping, and only auto-create Ops tickets for severity >= 3. :warning:

deploy-bot: Draft config uploaded: https://storage.redwood-inference.internal/configs/adaptive-batching-draft.yaml

Kevin Zhao: One more — KV-cache hinting: any PII concerns? we shouldn't leak prompts into cache keys.

Priya Patel: Good catch. Hinting will use hashed prefixes + salt; no raw prompt stored. We'll require KMS encryption and audit logs for cache accesses.

Tom Brooks: Can we get a concise MVP launch checklist? I'll use it for SRE signoff.

Priya Patel: MVP launch gates (proposed):
- pilot customer enabled + successful canary for 48h
- latency regressions <= 5% p95 for pilot
- quant recs with `memory_estimate` & doc
- eval-alert rule editor in Console + notify channel
- audit log + KMS enabled for cache hints

Marta Li: That looks reasonable. +1 to opt-in pilot.

Kevin Zhao: I'll scope the quant recs API and JSON fields and share PR by Tue.

Priya Patel: Thanks — I'll update RFC and add the gating checklist to the pilot doc. If no objections, locking scope tomorrow.

Tom Brooks:👍

Marta Li: 👍

Kevin Zhao: 👍
